summary: Iteration 2 — Personal Concierge + Live QR Scan features tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 27/28 passing (1 skipped: admin balance insufficient for repeat inner_experience). Tier-gate 403-before-400 fix verified. New concierge suite (7 tests) all green: member create, member GET, staff cross-venue 403, staff acknowledge/fulfill/decline, 404 on nonexistent msg. Frontend E2E on mobile (390x844) + desktop (1440x900): Mila login → nav-scan icon → /scan page → manual venue dropdown check-in → scan-success '+100' + updated balance ✔. VenueDetail 'Speak with the room' opens ConciergeModal, hold_table shows party+arrival fields, submit posts note ✔. Profile 'Your correspondence' section shows notes with status label 'Awaiting the room' ✔. Staff (Lumen) dashboard shows Correspondence tab with pending count badge (4), 5 concierge rows each with acknowledge/fulfill/decline buttons + reply textarea; PATCH succeeds ('Reply sent' toast) ✔. QR Code tab renders qr-display + checkin URL '/checkin/venue-lumen' ✔. Regression: no Staff link in member header, no Discover link in staff header ✔.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — non-critical dev-only warning triggered by dev-mode span wrappers around option text; harmless but noisy. Consider using shadcn Select or removing the wrapper for cleaner console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: concierge endpoints correctly guard by role and reuse _assert_staff_can_manage for cross-venue 403.
server.py: ConciergeUpdateIn allows response=None which is fine; empty string is coerced to None on update (good).
server.py: seed_database still overwrites venue status/capacity on every startup — carried over from iter 1; not blocking for demo.
Frontend: native <select> in Scan.jsx works but produces a React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> (dev wrappers). Not user-visible.
